title: Source/Data Pipeline Integrity & Academy Desynchronization Audit

central_finding.root_cause: populate-data.js's own header comment (present since Phase 5A, unmodified) instructs editors to treat data/academy.json as the permanent source of truth and edit it directly, while the script's mechanical behavior unconditionally overwrites that same file from scripts/data/academy-*.js on every run
central_finding.partially_patched_by: Phase 7Q (commit ae751ca) -- fixed an id collision symptom, not the root cause
central_finding.discovered_by: Phase 7X (regenerating academy.json for unrelated content edits)

scope_of_desync.unrelated_low_risk_finding: 3 dead legacy JSON files (chlorine-dosage.json, ph-adjustment.json, shock-dosage.json) with zero live readers, containing formulas already removed from live calculators

populate_data_js.reason: would silently delete fund-07 and fund-08 on next run

build_order.known_issue: generate-hubs.js runs before generate-navigation.js (documented since Phase 7V), requires 2 build passes to converge

sitewide_template_drift.evidence: clean npm run build with populate-data.js never invoked touched 241 files, dominated by entities/ (105) and calculators/ (15)

reproducibility.populate_data_js_isolated_determinism: confirmed byte-identical across 2 runs in an isolated temp directory
reproducibility.build_drift_experiment: reverted, not re-run, per no-broad-regeneration rule

phase_7z_recommendation: Decision-and-remediation phase: fix populate-data.js documentation, decide and execute fund-07/fund-08 disposition, consider a source-vs-JSON consistency validator, fix the 3 minor record-integrity findings
